full_name: Brigid Cohen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2026–2027 Humanities Perrin Moorhead Grayson and Bruns Grayson Fellow New York University
bio: Brigid Cohen is a historical musicologist who teaches at New York University and specializes in the history of music and migration, with related focuses on war, imperialism, archive studies, avant-garde communities, and intersections of music in the wider arts.
